description: A three-rung CI fixture in the Graphalytics archive format (.v, .e, .properties and per-algorithm reference outputs, hand-derived). ga-directed and ga-undirected pass; ga-wrong's BFS reference gives vertex 5 depth 2 where the true depth is 3, so it fails with reference_mismatch. archives/ is built from source/<id> with: tar --zstd --sort=name --mtime=@0 --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --mode=u+rw,go+r-w -cf archives/<id>.tar.zst -C source/<id> <files>
variance_line: Fixture: Graphalytics algorithms through GraphForge analyst verbs; PR and CDLP are refused.
attribution: Data format and reference-output format from LDBC Graphalytics (https://ldbcouncil.org/benchmarks/graphalytics/), used under CC-BY 4.0.
